fullPassage: A building is an inanimate object, but it is not an inarticulate one. Even the simplest house always makes a statement, one expressed in brick and stone, in wood and glass, rather than in words — but no less loud and obvious. When we see a rusting trailer surrounded by weeds and abandoned cars, or a brand-new mini-mansion with a high wall, we instantly get a message. In both of these cases, though in different accents, it is “Stay Out of Here.” It is not only houses, of course, that communicate with us. All kinds of buildings — churches, museums, schools, hospitals, restaurants, and offices — speak to us silently. Sometimes the statement is deliberate. A store or restaurant can be designed so that it welcomes mostly low-income or high-income customers. Buildings tell us what to think and how to act, though we may not register their messages consciously.

questions.passage: A building is an inanimate object, but it is not an inarticulate one. Even the simplest house always makes a statement, one expressed in brick and stone, in wood and glass, rather than in words — but no less loud and obvious. When we see a rusting trailer surrounded by weeds and abandoned cars, or a brand-new mini-mansion with a high wall, we instantly get a message. In both of these cases, though in different accents, it is “Stay Out of Here.” It is not only houses, of course, that communicate with us. All kinds of buildings — churches, museums, schools, hospitals, restaurants, and offices — speak to us silently. Sometimes the statement is deliberate. A store or restaurant can be designed so that it welcomes mostly low-income or high-income customers. Buildings tell us what to think and how to act, though we may not register their messages consciously.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 역사 속 건축 자재 / ② 오래된 집이 더 비싼 이유 / ③ 인기 있는 가게를 설계하는 법 / ④ 말 없이 말하는 건물
det.analysis:
✅ ④ Buildings Speak Without Words(말 없이 말하는 건물): 글의 핵심은 건물이 언어가 아니어도 우리에게 메시지를 전한다는 것이므로 제목으로 알맞아요 ←정답
❌ ① Building Materials Through History(역사 속 건축 자재): 벽돌·돌은 예시일 뿐 자재의 역사가 주제가 아니에요
❌ ② Why Old Houses Cost More(오래된 집이 더 비싼 이유): 집값 이야기는 본문에 없어요
❌ ③ How to Design a Popular Store(인기 가게 설계법): 가게 설계는 하나의 예시일 뿐 글 전체 주제가 아니에요
det.tip: 말이 아니어도 메시지를 전하는 건물 → Buildings Speak Without Words

ch: How to Design a Popular Store

❌ ③ 소리를 차단한다: 방음과는 관련이 없어요
❌ ④ 조용히 대화해야 한다: 사람의 행동 규칙이 아니라 건물의 소통을 가리켜요
det.tip: silently(말없이) speak → 언어 없이도 메시지를 전한다는 의인화 비유

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: vague and quiet=모호하고 조용한 / loud and obvious=크고 분명한 / brief and simple=짧고 단순한 / strange and rare=이상하고 드문
det.analysis:
✅ ② loud and obvious: 집은 말(언어) 대신 벽돌·유리로 진술을 하지만 그 진술이 '말에 못지않게(no less)' 강하다는 흐름이에요. 그러니 빈칸에는 말 못지않게 '크고 분명한(loud and obvious)'이 들어가야 해요 ←정답
❌ ① vague and quiet(모호하고 조용한): 'no less(못지않게)'의 강조와 정반대예요
❌ ③ brief and simple(짧고 단순한): 강도(强度)에 관한 흐름과 맞지 않아요
❌ ④ strange and rare(이상하고 드문): 문맥과 무관해요
det.tip: rather than in words — but no less ___ → 말 못지않게 '크고 분명한(loud and obvious)'

det.korean: welcome(맞이하다) → welcomes. 주어 it(3인칭 단수)에 맞춰 동사에 -s를 붙인다.

det.tip: 3인칭 단수 주어(it) + 현재시제 → 동사에 -s (welcome → welcomes)
